scenes.chapter: Chapter 4  The future he never saw
lines: When he died of cancer at only forty-eight,
no one had yet shown he was right.
Eight years later, Heinrich Hertz

Today, radio, TV, phones and Wi-Fi

Einstein said: one scientific epoch ended,
